## Question 1 (3 points)

Consider the following joint PMF for $X$ and $Y$:

$$
P_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac{2x+y}{225} \text{ for } x,y \in \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\} \text{ and } 0 \text{ otherwise}
$$

Create a function that computes the marginal probability of $X$ for any value $x$. Then use this to compute $P_{X}(2)$

```{r, echo = TRUE}
PX_11 <- function(x){
  1/225*(10*x + 15)
}

cat("PX_11(2) is:", PX_11(2))
```

## Question 2 (3 points)

Consider the following joint PDF for $X$ and $Y$ below:

$$
f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac{(x+y)^2}{216} \text{ for } x,y \in (-3, 3) \text{ and } 0 \text{ otherwise}
$$

Write a function that computes the conditional distribution of $X$ given $Y$. Then use this function to compute $f_{X|Y}(2|3)$.

```{r, echo = TRUE}
fX.Y_12 <- function(x, y){
  1/6*(x+y)^2/(y^2+3)
}

cat("fX.Y_12(2,3) is:", fX.Y_12(2, 3))
```

## Question 3 (4 points)

Again, consider the following joint PDF for $X$ and $Y$ below:

$$
f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac{(x+y)^2}{216} \text{ for } x,y \in (-3, 3) \text{ and } 0 \text{ otherwise}
$$

Provide the necessary code needed below to compute $\text{E}[XY]$.

```{r, echo = TRUE}
EXY_13 <- integrate(function(y) {
  sapply(y, function(z){
    integrate(function(x){
      x*z*(x+z)^2/216
    }, lower = -3, upper = 3)$value
  })
}, lower = -3, upper = 3)$value

cat("E[XY] is:", EXY_13)
```

## Question 4 (3 points)

Once again, consider the following joint PDF for $X$ and $Y$ below:

$$
f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac{(x+y)^2}{216} \text{ for } x,y \in (-3, 3) \text{ and } 0 \text{ otherwise}
$$

Provide the necessary code needed below to compute $\text{Cov}(X, Y)$.

```{r, echo = TRUE}
EX <- integrate(function(x) x*1/36*(x^2+3), lower = -3, upper = 3)$value

EY <- integrate(function(y) y*1/36*(y^2+3), lower = -3, upper = 3)$value

CovXY <- EXY_13 - EX*EY

cat("Cov(X,Y) is:", CovXY)
```

What does this say about the relationship between $X$ and $Y$?

[This means there is a positive linear relationship between $X$ and $Y$, as one goes up, the other tends to go up as well.]{style="color: red;"}
